crossRefs.note: The tablets were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, engraved on the tablets.
They made a calf in Horeb, and worshiped a molten image.

people.name: Sinai
people.line: Mountain where Moses received the Ten Commandments

translations.web: Also in Horeb you provoked Yahweh to wrath, and Yahweh was angry with you to destroy you.
translations.bsb: At Horeb you provoked the LORD, and He was angry enough to destroy you.
translations.kjv: Also in Horeb ye provoked the LORD to wrath, so that the LORD was angry with you to have destroyed
translations.asv: Also in Horeb ye provoked Jehovah to wrath, and Jehovah was angry with you to destroy you.
